subject: Request: Pilot keepalive and additional sandbox credits — pipeline stall

Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@clevercart.io>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — blocker on our side (integration stall)

Hi Jonas,

Quick update from our engineering team — the third-party payments connector we planned to use for the pilot is returning intermittent 502s for batching endpoints, and it’s caused us to pause the connector work. We were planning to run the Redwood pilot next week but we need another 3–4 weeks to resolve the vendor issue and validate end-to-end flows.

We really want to keep the pilot intact but are short on runway. Two asks:
- Can you extend our pilot window by 30 days so we don’t lose the current provisioning?
- Can you top up our sandbox credits by ~50k tokens to cover an extended QA window once the connector is back?

I attached the latest integration logs (integration-log-aug01.txt) and a short summary from our eng lead. If you need engineering details, Tom can share traces.

Appreciate any flexibility — we’re committed to moving forward once the vendor is stable.

Thanks,
Alyssa Green
Head of Platform, CleverCart
alyssa.green@clevercart.io

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear about the vendor flakiness, that’s frustrating.

We can be flexible here. I’ll loop in Marissa from Customer Success to coordinate an interim approval for an extension and provisional credit top-up while we validate the failure mode. Quick plan:
1) I’ll ask CS to provision a 30-day pilot extension and a 50k token sandbox top-up as a provisional grant pending review.
2) CS will confirm with your engineering owner once consumption patterns look good to avoid accidental overages.
3) If the vendor issue looks like it will be longer than 30 days, we’ll discuss structured make-good terms tied to the CleverCart rollout timeline.

Would you like us to keep the current reserved environment and just extend the access window, or do you prefer a pause-and-resume (we can snapshot state either way)?

Jonas Weber

Forwarding Alyssa's note and logs. Alyssa/Tom — thanks for the context. I pulled usage and current provisioning for CleverCart. Current sandbox quota: 120k tokens remaining; pilot expires 2026-08-10.

Requested: 30-day extension + 50k token top-up.

Internal note for approval routing:
- Small, time-limited top-up (50k tokens) — falls under CS discretionary credits for pilots if we attach a short mutual action plan (MAP) and an engineering acceptance checkpoint.
- Will need Ben (Sales Manager) sign-off for credits >40k tokens for a named pilot.

I’ve drafted a concise MAP (attached as pilot-mop-draft.pdf) that ties the extension to two acceptance criteria: 1) vendor connector stable for 48h under staging load, 2) smoke tests pass across three flows. If approved, I will:
  * Extend pilot expiry by 30 days (new expiry 2026-09-09)
  * Apply provisional +50k token top-up to sandbox account with consumption alerts
  * Schedule a check-in with CleverCart eng in 10 days to review traces

Ben — can you confirm approval for the 50k provisional credit and the extension?

— Marissa
